title: One operating system for shared mobility.
summary: Synchoo connects vehicle rental, verified driver hire, car pooling and vehicle care in one role-aware marketplace with payments, trust controls and trip operations built in.
positioning: Four distinct mobility services create fragmented journeys for customers and operators.
Trust, availability, handover, payments and incident evidence must remain connected across every booking.
Synchoo brings these operational layers into one product while keeping each booking workflow independent.

services.title: Vehicle rental
services.detail: Search verified vehicles, schedule precise pickup and return times, pay, complete QR handover and manage the trip.

services.title: Driver hire
services.detail: Discover licence-reviewed drivers, book by hour or day, pay after confirmation and follow a dedicated hire lifecycle.

services.title: Car pooling
services.detail: Drivers publish routes and seats; riders discover nearby trips and submit requests that drivers accept or decline.

services.title: Vehicle wash
services.detail: Customers request a service slot; operations confirms availability before payment and fulfilment.

capabilities: Role-aware customer, host, driver and administrator experiences
Wallet and card payment paths with ledger-backed transactions
Live trip location sharing for active rental bookings
Fuel, odometer, damage and photo inspection records
Verification queues for customers, hosts, vehicles and drivers
Reviews, vendor responses, reports and dispute resolution
In-app event notifications and printable booking receipts
Self-service data export and account anonymisation controls

roles.title: Customers
roles.detail: Discover, book, pay, hand over, track, review and raise supported disputes.

roles.title: Hosts
roles.detail: Complete verification, publish approved vehicles, manage availability, bookings and trip evidence.

roles.title: Drivers
roles.detail: Create a verified profile, control availability and manage hire or pooling requests.

roles.title: Wash partners
roles.detail: Participate in an admin-coordinated service workflow with approval before payment.

roles.title: Administrators
roles.detail: Review identity and vehicle records, coordinate washing capacity and resolve disputes.

rentalLifecycle: Search verified inventory and select an available time window
Authenticate, confirm the booking and complete payment
Use booking-scoped chat and precise pickup location
Scan QR and record pickup inspection before trip start
Share live location during the active booking
Record return inspection, complete handover and receive a receipt
Leave a review or open an evidence-backed dispute when needed

architecture.detail: Responsive React interfaces and role-aware navigation
TanStack Start routing, server functions and protected workflows
Postgres data, authentication, storage, realtime events and row-level access controls
Razorpay payment flows and Google Maps location experiences

trust: Role checks and row-level policies restrict sensitive records
Verification state gates customer booking and public vehicle visibility
Payment signatures are verified on the server before confirmation
Booking membership gates messages, tracking and dispute access
Inspection photos and handover timestamps preserve trip evidence
Data export and deletion controls support user privacy operations

readiness.label: Implemented
readiness.detail: Four service lines, wallet/card payments, QR handover, verification, chat, tracking, inspections, disputes, reviews and notifications.

readiness.label: Verified in repository
readiness.detail: Automated in-memory lifecycle simulations cover rentals, pooling, driver hire, washing and wallet scenarios.

readiness.label: Requires deployment validation
readiness.detail: Live payment credentials, production monitoring, delivery messaging and end-to-end tests against the deployed database and UI.

roadmap.detail: Marketplace services, role-based operations, verification, payments and trip controls.
Deployed end-to-end test coverage, observability, service-level dashboards and reconciliation tooling.
Partner onboarding automation, demand intelligence, fleet tools and controlled geographic expansion.

caveats: No traction, revenue, market-size or customer adoption claims are included because the repository does not substantiate them.
The existing automated suite models lifecycle rules in memory; it is not a substitute for deployed database and browser end-to-end testing.
The install experience is manifest-based; offline caching and background sync are not currently established.
Vehicle-rental cancellation refund automation was not verified in the audited implementation; driver-hire and wash refund workflows are present.
